reports.notes: Same filer as key 9162c34a, the post-election report. itemized.notes: Page-face candidate 'Kim Jackson' (Republican, Office Seeking 'Treasurer', residence city Orem) — index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the page face supplies it. 4 pages: p1 is the county's 2014 blank cover ('2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES', Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5), report type '30 Days after the General Election' ticked, amendment answered 'No', signed 12/4/2014. NEW SOURCE PROPERTY: pp2-4 are NOT the county's printed Summary Page / Schedule A / Schedule B at all — this filer substituted THREE PAGES OF HIS OWN TYPED (spreadsheet-produced) LEDGER, headed 'Summary Page', 'Contributions Received' and 'Expenditures Made', reproducing the county's line labels and its four-column schedule shape but with no printed grid rules beyond the header underline and no 'Subtotal for this page' line. This is the PORTRAIT analogue of the landscape case in ADDENDUM A §A2 (Witney 2010): the county FORM is missing, the filer's ENTRIES are not, so the sides are transcribed/empty-schedule on their own terms and NOT 'no-schedule-page'. The 4-page count (pdfinfo) confirms nothing is missing. CONTRIBUTIONS SIDE = empty-schedule: p3 'Contributions Received' prints its four column headings ('Date / Name of Contributor / Mailing Address & Zip Code / Amount') over their underlines and NOTHING BELOW THEM — no entries, no 'None' banner, no total line; a 400 dpi strip crop of the 12% of page height below the header rule rendered white. Consistent with the Summary Page, which prints a BARE DASH for Contributions Received 'This Period' and again on the balance-summary 'Total Contributions Received' line — under the zero-glyph ruling a bare dash is a nil mark, NOT a numeral, so no zero is claimed and the module's published stated total for contributions stays blank; the ladder nonetheless requires the period's contributions to be nil (4,019.95 + x - 4,014.95 = 5.00 => x = 0). The typeset is Excel's accounting format, in which '$    -' is how that program prints zero, but the glyph on the page is a dash and it is transcribed as one. Year-to-Date contributions 46,422.13 and expenditures 46,417.13 are cumulative and never summed. This is the filer's post-election wind-up report — same filer as key 9162c34a per the cover tranche's note.
